title: Climbing Hook
description: A movement tool that pulls players upward when held near blocks.
body:
# Climbing Hook – Stealthy Wall Scaling Tool
A minimalist climbing tool that lets you climb over walls 3 blocks or taller—no grappling, no clunky block-placing, just fluid ascension when you need it most!

## 📜 How It Works:
Approach any solid wall (at least 3 blocks tall).

Pull yourself over—smooth and silent!

## ✨ Key Features:
✔ Works on any block – Stone, wood, even modded blocks!

✔ Balanced for survival – Durability/stamina costs.

✔ No awkward physics – Not a grapple, just straight-up climbing.

✔ Multiplayer-friendly – Works on servers with almost no lag.

✔ Environment physics – Increases difficulty to climb when it rains.

## 🎯 Perfect For:
Stealth gameplay – Sneak over walls undetected.

Adventure maps – Secret paths and shortcuts.

Builders – Quick access to tall structures.

Hardcore survival – Escape mobs or scale cliffs fast.

### Why This Over Other Climbing Mods?
→ No swing mechanics – Pure vertical movement.

→ Not OP – Requires minimum height, so no cheesing 1-block gaps.

→ Immersive – Feels like a tool, not a hack.
